toplevel: Header comment (10-26): canonical source, created 2026-04-26 (audit PERM-1) to replace INFOPLIST_KEY overrides; NSHealthUpdate copy rewritten to drop contradictory 'does not write' text (PERM-6). Keys: CFBundleDisplayName Emuqu; WKApplication true; UISupportedInterfaceOrientations portrait/upside-down (ignored on watchOS); WKWatchOnly false; WKCompanionAppBundleIdentifier com.chrissharp.flowrecovery (matches iOS PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER); WKBackgroundModes workout-processing (keeps the app alive under an HKWorkoutSession). Purpose strings: HealthShare (reads wrist heart rate during a workout, streams to iPhone, fills in for strap dropouts) - matches WatchWorkoutManager.swift:57-62 (share workoutType, read heartRate); HealthUpdate says the watch session is discarded and the iPhone saves the workout - matches WatchWorkoutManager.swift:180-186 (endCollection then session.end(), never finishWorkout); BluetoothAlways for direct strap connection (WatchStrapConnector CBCentralManager). Excluded from the synchronized group's membership (pbxproj 2117-2124) and used via INFOPLIST_FILE.
